name: HoYoFair 2023
description: Hello, everyone! The HoYoFair New Year 2023: Genshin Impact Fan Art Special Program broadcast has come to an end~ Did you like it? Would you also like to have the opportunity to get your wishes fulfilled by Tubby like the Traveler? As the new year approaches, if you could ask Tubby to make your wish come true, what would you wish for? Take part in the event and share your wishes now!
